title: SIEMBox content pack
description: A per-technology bundle that references catalog content (parsers by name, detections by category/tag/name, SigmaHQ rules by id) and carries a setup guide. Files are packs/<id>.pack.yaml. CI runs SIEMBox's validate-packs, which also checks that the references resolve and that the guide markdown has no raw HTML, images or unsafe links.

id.description: Unique kebab-case pack id; the file is packs/<id>.pack.yaml.

description.description: One or two sentences shown on the pack card. Plain text.

icon.description: Element Plus icon the Content Packs page shows.

version.description: Bump whenever parsers, detections or sigma change: installs compare their snapshot with the current pack and show the difference as "What's new".

parsers.description: Catalog parser names (the `name` field of parsers/*.parser.json).

detections.description: Catalog detections the pack installs: any rule matching one of these.

sigma.description: SigmaHQ rules, installed through SIEMBox's SigmaHQ library. Pick rules the SIEMBox converter handles, that the regex safety gate accepts, and whose fields the pack's parsers emit.

title.description: The Sigma rule's title (shown while SIEMBox's SigmaHQ library is not loaded).

setup.description: The setup guide, shown before install. At most 20000 characters in all.

text.description: Markdown. No raw HTML, no images; links must be http(s), mailto or relative. Put placeholders like <host> in `code`.

code.description: Optional snippet shown verbatim (a shipper or compose config, a command).
